title: Cash Purchases Beyond the Limit: Units on First-Time Quantity Limit Exceptions
content:
Cash purchases show need beyond the limit. When a first-time quantity limit exception on an acute migraine drug is approved under the Utilization Management Program, paper claims the member submitted for the drug under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit that were denied because a coverage review was required add units to the approval ceiling:

- **2 or more** such paper claims for the drug, with the denial dated within the last 6 months: **2 units**;
- **exactly 1** such denial: **1 unit**;
- **none**: nothing.

Only denials for the reason that a coverage review was required count, and only for the drug the exception concerns. The 6 months end on the decision date: a denial counts when dated after the same day of the month six months before the decision date.

## Examples (hypothetical)

| Paper-claim denials for the drug, reason coverage review required, within 6 months | Other paper-claim denials | Units |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 0 | 2 |
| 2 | 0 | 2 |
| 1 | 2 (other reasons) | 1 |
| 0 | 1 (another reason) | 0 |
